title: Data Center - Worldwide
highlights: Revenue in the Data Center market is forecasted to reach US$538.91bn in 2026.
Network Infrastructure leads the market with a projected market volume of US$284.01bn in 2026.
An annual growth rate (CAGR 2026-2031) of 8.48% is expected to drive revenue to US$809.59bn by 2031.
In global comparison, the United States will generate the most revenue ( US$168.51bn in 2026).
In the worldwide Data Center market, the United States leads in innovative technologies and sustainable solutions.
